## 问题与改动 / Problem and change

说明具体触发条件、改动前后行为，关联 Issue（如有）。
Describe the trigger, before/after behavior, and related issue if any.

## 验证 / Validation

- [ ] `node scripts/check.mjs` 通过 / passes
- [ ] 界面改动已检查窄屏及明暗模式，或说明不适用 / UI changes checked at narrow widths and in light/dark modes, or explained as not applicable
- [ ] 截图、日志和配置已脱敏 / Evidence contains no personal data or secrets

测试环境、截图与尚未验证的范围 / Environment, screenshots and untested scope:

## 许可 / Licensing

请保留第三方署名和许可，只提交有权贡献的内容。
Preserve third-party attribution and only submit material you have the right to contribute.
